i.norm: Verifies that ElementIterator.tail() silently ignores a null node. The NodeVisitor.tail() callback is only meaningful when the node is an Element instance. When null is passed, the "instanceof Element" guard evaluates to false and the method returns without performing any action, so no NullPointerException should be thrown.
Arrange: build a StreamParser backed by an XML parser and obtain its ElementIterator
Act & Assert: calling tail() with a null node and an arbitrary depth should not throw
